title: AMC_LCDM_Case_#1
source_name_ch1: Laser capture microdissected (LCMD) tumors from the formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) TURBT specimens
tissue_2: Laser capture microdissected (LCMD) tumors from the formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) TURBT specimens
treatment_protocol_ch1: The ASAN cohort was classified into two groups showing marked contrast in NAC response: NAC response (R) patients with the absence of residual invasive tumor and NAC nonresponse (NR) patients with large residual MIBC (4.9 ± 2.5 cm) in the radical/partial cystectomy specimens.
growth_protocol_ch1: This retrospective study was approved by the Institutional Review Board of Asan Medical Center (AMC; 2020-0064). It included 105 consecutive MIBC (cT2-4aN0M0) patients who underwent TUR with available formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tumor tissues and at least 3 cycles of NAC between August 2011 and August 2017 at AMC. Among the 105 patients, 60 patients who underwent curative surgery after NAC were designated as validation cohort since their pathologic response of NAC was assessable using the surgical specimens.
extract_protocol_ch1: Laser capture microdissection (LCMD) was performed on hematoxylin-eosin-stained tissue slides using a Leica LMD6500 laser capture dissection microscope (Leica Microsystems) as described by the manufacturer. The urothelial carcinoma areas were meticulously microdissected as close as possible to the perimeter of tumor cells to avoid contamination of stroma and inflammatory cells while avoiding tumor necrotic area. Total RNA from the LCMD tumor tissues was isolated using the RNeasy Mini Kit (QIAGEN, Valencia, CA), including treatment with DNase I (QIAGEN)
extract_protocol_ch1_2: RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using LEXOGEN Quant-Seq Library Prep Kit (Cat#001.24) standard protocols.
data_processing: Illumina Casava1.8 software used for basecalling.
data_processing_2: Sequenced reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence, and masked for low-complexity or low-quality sequence(using fastx_trimmer), then mapped to hg19 (UCSC) whole genome using Bowtie2
data_processing_5: Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text files include read count values for each Sample
contact_institute: University of Ulsan College of Medicine
